name: Xteink X4 Pro
description: 4.2 inch monochrome ePaper e-reader, ESP32-S3 sibling of the X4 with capacitive touch and a warm/cool frontlight. Same 800x480 SSD1677 panel mounted portrait (480x800 presentation) and the same 48000-byte 1-bpp wire format, so the frame is byte-identical to the xteink_x4 target.
notes_md:
Panel block confirmed on real hardware via the grayscale sibling `xteink_x4_pro_gray`, which shares it: a dashboard composed at 480x800 and packed at the 800x480 native stride renders upright on an X4 Pro running CrossInk, so both the geometry and `portrait_flipped` are measured rather than inherited from the X4.

The 1-bpp path itself has not been exercised on an X4 Pro, only the 2-bpp one. It is the same frame at half the size through `esp32_bw_bin`, which is confirmed on the X4 (same SSD1677 controller, 800x480, 48000 bytes), so the remaining risk is small. The board profile differs from the X4 only in MCU (ESP32-S3), touch, frontlight and a PSRAM-backed framebuffer.

See `xteink_x4_pro_gray` for the 4-level grayscale variant of the same panel; the released CrossInk `x4-pro` build ships with grayscale on and announces that id.
